start a family: Tom and Lisa got married last year, and they hope to start a family in a few years.
湯姆和麗莎去年結婚，他們希望幾年後成家。
start a business: After graduating, she borrowed money from her parents to start a business of her own.
畢業後，她向父母借錢來創業，開一家屬於自己的公司。
start a fire: We collected some dry wood and leaves to start a fire and keep warm at the campsite.
我們收集了一些乾木頭和樹葉來生火，好在營地保暖。
start a fight: Mark is always angry and rude, so he often tries to start a fight with other students.
馬克總是又生氣又無禮，所以他常常想跟其他同學挑起爭端。
start the ball rolling: To start the ball rolling, I will share my idea first, and then everyone else can join in.
為了開始行動，我會先分享我的想法，然後其他人都可以加入討論。
get off to a good start: Our team got off to a good start by scoring two goals in the first ten minutes of the game.
我們隊開頭順利，在比賽的前十分鐘就進了兩球。
be startled by the noise: The sleeping baby was startled by the noise of the fireworks and began to cry loudly.
熟睡的嬰兒被煙火的聲音嚇到，開始大聲哭了起來。
startle the horse: Please speak quietly near the farm, or you may startle the horse and it might run away.
在農場附近請小聲說話，不然你可能會驚嚇馬匹，牠可能會跑掉。
a startling discovery: Scientists were amazed when they made a startling discovery of frozen water deep under the surface of Mars.
科學家們有了一個驚人的發現：在火星表面深處發現冰凍的水，令他們大感驚訝。
startle someone out of sleep: The loud thunder in the middle of the night startled me out of sleep, and I could not sleep again.
半夜響亮的雷聲把我驚醒，然後我就再也睡不著了。
starve for attention: Left alone at home all day, the little dog was starving for attention when we finally came back.
那隻小狗整天被獨自留在家裡，當我們終於回來時，牠非常渴望關注。
be starved of funds: The small village school is starved of funds, so it cannot buy new books or computers for its students.
那所小村莊學校經費匱乏，所以無法為學生購買新書或電腦。
starve to death: Without enough food, many wild animals in the frozen forest may starve to death this winter.
沒有足夠的食物，這座冰封森林裡的許多野生動物今年冬天可能會餓死。
starve the enemy out: The army surrounded the city and cut off all food supplies to starve the enemy out.
軍隊包圍了城市並切斷所有糧食供應，以斷糧逼降敵人。
starving for news: After the earthquake, worried families were starving for news about their missing relatives.
地震過後，憂心的家屬們非常渴望得到有關失蹤親人的消息。
state one's opinion: In the class meeting, every student had a chance to state his or her opinion about the school trip.
在班會上，每位學生都有機會陳述自己對校外教學的意見。
state the facts: When the police officer asked what happened, the witness calmly stated the facts in just a few sentences.
當警察問發生了什麼事時，目擊者只用幾句話冷靜地陳述事實。
as stated above: As stated above, all students must hand in their science reports to the teacher by Friday.
如上所述，所有學生必須在星期五前把自然科報告交給老師。
state clearly: In your application letter, please state clearly why you want to join our volunteer team.
在你的申請信中，請清楚說明你為什麼想加入我們的志工團隊。
state one's case: Each side was given ten minutes to state its case before the judges made their final decision.
在評審做出最後決定之前，每一方都有十分鐘陳述立場。
be stationed abroad: My uncle is a soldier, and he was stationed abroad for three years before he came home.
我叔叔是一名軍人，他在回國之前駐紮海外三年。
station guards at the gate: After the robbery, the school decided to station guards at the gate to keep strangers out.
搶案發生後，學校決定在門口派駐警衛，不讓陌生人進入。
station oneself by the door: Every morning, the kind teacher stationed herself by the door to greet each student with a smile.
每天早上，那位親切的老師都站在門邊，用微笑迎接每位學生。
stay calm: During an earthquake, you should stay calm and hide under a strong table until the shaking stops.
地震時，你應該保持冷靜，躲在堅固的桌子下，直到搖晃停止。
stay the course: Training for a marathon is really tough, but if you stay the course, you will cross the finish line.
為馬拉松受訓真的很辛苦，但如果你堅持到底，你就會跨過終點線。
stay in touch: Although my best friend moved to Canada, we still stay in touch by video calls every week.
雖然我最好的朋友搬到加拿大，我們仍然每週用視訊通話保持聯絡。
stay put: Stay put here by the ticket office while I go and find out which platform our train leaves from.
在售票處這裡待在原地，我去查查我們的火車從哪個月台出發。
stay ahead of: To stay ahead of other companies, we must keep creating new and better products every year.
為了領先其他公司，我們每年都必須持續創造更新更好的產品。
stay up late: Don't stay up late tonight, because you have an important exam early tomorrow morning.
今晚不要熬夜，因為你明天一大早有一場重要的考試。
stay out of trouble: My mother always tells me to stay out of trouble at school and focus on my studies.
我媽媽總是叫我在學校別惹麻煩，要專心讀書。
stay afloat: During the difficult months of the pandemic, many small restaurants struggled to stay afloat.
在疫情艱難的那幾個月裡，許多小餐廳努力維持營運。
